metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and somehow scored a kill? Valorant, why tho?
metadata.description:
That one kill where I wasn’t even aiming.
Enemy probably uninstalling just to rethink life.
Valorant logic: handing out freebies like it’s casual Tuesday.
If your aim’s a mystery but kills show up, you’re not alone.

Hit that like if your best kill felt like pure accident!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
